description: ARRI Alexa anamorphic widescreen film look. Choose grade: warm golden, cool noir, or moody desaturated. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: warm_golden = late-afternoon honey. cool_noir = neon-fill desaturated. moody_desaturated = soft window low-contrast.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".

name: apply_cinematic_anamorphic
title: Apply Cinematic Anamorphic
